This directory contains the browser and worker modules and predefined Adobe
character maps from Mozilla's pdfjs-dist 6.5.438. They are served locally to
extract text from PDFs, including documents that use predefined CJK mappings.

The JavaScript modules are distributed under the Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE).
The character maps carry their separate notice in cmaps/LICENSE.

Upstream release: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438
